title: FFmpeg lut3d interpolation discriminator — experiment brief + synthetic test harness
purpose: Provide an executable test package that answers the two questions left open in art_01M6VM5DCRRQ32378328NBG3XG r1: (1) which interpolation mode is the FFmpeg default, and (2) whether nearest/trilinear/tetrahedral produce a measurable pixel difference on a smooth gradient. The package generates a known synthetic gradient PNG, produces three minimal .cube LUT files (identity, strong lift, strong crush), and emits the exact FFmpeg command lines to run. No command is executed here; outputs are proposals until someone runs them.

execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
